personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK infused with 3 Editorial typography
personality_one_liner: A sacred, elegant spiritual sanctuary utilizing editorial-grade serif typography, deep mystic surfaces, and golden accents to foster profound personal growth.

spacing.rule: Generous, editorial-style breathing room. Let typography and content breathe. Never dense.

do's: Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and bottom sheet drag handles.
Use over deep atmospheric background images for featured article cards.
dont's: Do not apply to body text regions, standard lists, or reading view content.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the spiritual sanctuary and authenticate the user via phone and password.

states.loading: Subtle golden spinner centered on dark background.
states.error: Elegant toast with red accent and minimal text.

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark atmospheric background. The logo sits prominently centered. A refined glass bottom sheet slides up for the phone/password input. Inputs are clean, single-column, with labels above.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover articles, administrative posts, and daily divulgative content.

states.loading: Skeleton text blocks matching the editorial layout.
states.empty: Icon of a serene tree with 'New wisdom will arrive soon.'
states.error: Readable message on dark surface with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Editorial reading layout. A large hero article card at the top utilizing a dark nature image with a gradient scrim and a large serif title. Below it, a segmented control or horizontal chip list for categories. Articles appear in a vertical list with large serif typography and generous line height. Tab bar features a glass background.

screens.name: Library / Categories
screens.purpose: Browse the extensive list of disciplines (Quantum physics, Meditation, etc.) and Video content.
screens.layout: A 2-column grid of cards. Each card uses abstract, dark spiritual or nature imagery (e.g., forest, quantum visuals) overlaid with a 70% black-to-transparent gradient scrim and a serif title in the bottom left corner.

screens.name: Article Detail
screens.purpose: Provide a distraction-free, elegant reading experience mimicking high-end literary magazines.
screens.layout: Content-first approach. Large serif headline, subtle gold accents, and a strict reading measure (padding on sides). Muted off-white text for body to reduce eye strain. Share buttons (Telegram/WhatsApp) are anchored in a sticky glass bottom bar.

screens.name: Paywall / Subscription
screens.purpose: Convert users to the advanced paid area with 3/6/12 months courses access.
screens.layout: High-leverage product surface. Outcome-led headline ('Unlock Ancient Wisdom'). Displays pricing tiers with the 12-month annual plan visually badged ('Best Value') and pre-selected. Single, full-width sticky golden CTA button at the bottom. Features 3-5 skimmable benefits with golden checkmarks.

screens.name: Messages / Inbox
screens.purpose: View personal messages and community updates from the admin.

states.empty: An elegant illustration of a closed letter with 'Your inbox is quiet.'

screens.layout: Clean, unboxed vertical list of message rows. Each row features a subtle unread indicator (a golden dot), a serif sender name ('Admin'), a truncated preview, and a timestamp.

quantum_physics.alt: Abstract visualization of blue magnetic field lines

spiritual_light.alt: Spiritual light rays shining through trees

philosophy.alt: Old vintage philosophy books in dark setting

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark mystic color palette (Midnight/Forest Green base '#0A0F0D'). Do not use ANY shades of blue or purple, as requested in the design rules.
Implement an elegant typographic hierarchy using Cormorant Garamond (or Playfair Display) for all headings/titles and Geist (or Satoshi) for body text.

For the reading view (Article Detail), emulate a high-end literary magazine: use muted off-white text against the dark background, ensure generous line-height (1.5x), and restrict text width with horizontal padding for optimal readability.

When rendering the logo provided by the user (white background with gold accents), enclose the `Image` component within a solid white circular container with `overflow: 'hidden'` so it pops cleanly against the dark app theme without ugly square corners.

Apply a vertical linear gradient scrim (from transparent down to ≥80% `surfaceInverse` or `surface`) over ALL background images (like category cards and hero images) to ensure overlaid text remains WCAG readable.
The Subscription Paywall should default to selecting the 12-month option, highlight it visually with a 'Best Value' golden tag, and use a sticky full-width golden CTA button.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Stick to a single weight (e.g., thin or regular) to maintain the elegant, refined aesthetic.
Add subtle haptic feedback for key interactions (e.g., category selection, opening an article, pressing the golden CTA).
